title: Law of Demeter
points: A method should only talk to its immediate friends: itself, its fields, its parameters, objects it creates.
trade: Fluent builders and stream pipelines are fine (same object or type returned). Overdoing it creates lots of pass-through wrapper methods.
answer: The caller depends on the internal structure of Order, Customer and Address. Any change to that structure breaks every caller.

questions.question: Which call chain most clearly violates the Law of Demeter?
questions.explanation: The caller must know the Order to Customer to Address structure. Builders and streams return the same type, so they are fine.
